articles.title: Amazon's Secret Lego Stash Is Bursting with Prime Day Deals!
articles.summary: Prime Day is here, and Amazon's hidden Lego section is packed with discounts up to 40% off! Grab sets from Star Wars, Harry Potter, and more before they vanish. Some are almost retired!

articles.title: Mary Bennet Is Back! 'The Other Bennet Sister' Gets a Cozy Christmas Special
articles.summary: The quietest Bennet sister is getting her own three-part Christmas special! Mary Bennet returns after her wedding to explore what happens next. It'll film in Wales and air on BritBox during the holidays.

articles.title: Can Life Keep Up When the Planet Changes Too Fast? Scientists Have a New Answer
articles.summary: MIT scientists found that mass extinctions happen when the environment changes faster than animals can adapt. Their new model matches real extinction events from the last 450 million years.
